integrity: The universal claim is proved from the classical Routh formula by a strict-convexity and cyclic-averaging argument; computation is used only as supplementary replayable verification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to positive finite cevian ratios and ordinary interior side divisions.
Targeted searches and two inspected primary full texts did not reveal an equivalent fixed-product profile, but older literature may contain one under different notation.
title: Sharp Routh-area profile at fixed Ceva product
